cardOverview.overviewText: SBM (State Bank of Mauritius) and MobiKwik have partnered to offer a seamless digital payment solution. This collaboration allows SBM customers to link their accounts with MobiKwik, facilitating quick and easy transactions, mobile recharges, and bill payments through the MobiKwik platform.
